text: Yonex Co., Ltd. (ヨネックス株式会社) is a sporting-goods maker headquartered in Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, founded in 1946 (established 1958), whose company profile names Arisa Yoneyama (アリサ ヨネヤマ) of the founding family as president and states capital of ¥4.706 billion.
short: Yonex Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo-listed sports-equipment maker headed by the founding Yoneyama family.
